settings.title: Legal vs illegal — the simple version
settings.body: What actually makes an e-bike, e-scooter or motorised device road legal, and what turns it into an unregistered motorbike in the eyes of the law.

settings.title: The rules, the fines, the risks
settings.body: Speed limits, helmets, footpaths and paths, age limits — plus what police are seeing in the community and the penalties families get caught by.

settings.title: Buying safely for your kids
settings.body: How to spot a dodgy import or modified build before you buy, and what to look for in a bike that will still be legal next year.

settings.title: Battery and charging fire safety
settings.body: Why cheap batteries catch fire, how to charge and store safely at home, and the warning signs to never ignore.

settings.question: What happens at the session?
settings.answer: A relaxed, plain-English workshop covering the rules, safety and buying advice — with legal and illegal devices in the room so you can see the difference. Bring your questions.

settings.question: How long does it run?
settings.answer: Around 60–90 minutes including questions. We'll confirm the format when we book you in.

settings.question: Who should attend?
settings.answer: Parents, teenagers, residents, schools, councils and community groups — anyone riding, buying, or worried about e-bikes and e-scooters in their neighbourhood.

settings.question: Is it a sales pitch?
settings.answer: No. It's community education. We'll answer product questions if you ask, and that's it.

settings.question: Can you bring bikes to look at?
settings.answer: Yes — we can bring compliant bikes so families can see and, where there's space, try a legal setup for themselves.
